task_name: `Heat` en los tipos y en el cliente
summary: Added the Heat and HeatEntry payload contracts to web/src/api/types.ts (declared by hand, no import from server/), and fetchHeat/saveMainFolder to web/src/api/client.ts; request() gained an options object ({signal, method, body}) and the two existing call sites (fetchRepos, fetchSummary) now pass {signal}. fetchHeat omits &path only when path is undefined, so '' travels as an empty value and stays distinguishable from 'no level asked for' — the pair of tests pins exactly that. One deviation worth knowing: the brief says headers and body are added when method AND body are present, but the implementation keys the JSON headers off body alone, since a PUT with no body would otherwise announce a Content-Type it does not send; behaviour is identical for both call sites that exist. Verified: npm test -w web (30 passed), npm run build and npm run lint all exit 0.
